errors.text: The hypothesis treats the transition primarily as a function of aging time at a fixed temperature, whereas the target transition is governed by aging temperature, with embrittlement near 600°C and recovery near 750°C.
It does not identify the specific as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 FCC+B2 eutectic high-entropy alloy.

The proposed mechanism of brittle-phase nucleation followed by precipitate coarsening or transformation misses the target mechanism: enhanced L12 ordering in FCC domains, elevated APBE and modulus, restricted cross-slip and planar slip, and stress concentration at jagged FCC/B2 phase-boundary tips.
The proposed recovery mechanism does not capture reduced L12 ordering and formation of ductile transition zones along phase boundaries at 750°C.
